'''Boyse''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In command of the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], Boyse oversaw the dealings of the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]] from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Exchequer/Legends|Exchequer]]''.
